# Frontend / Backend Stack

## Frontend

- React 18 + TypeScript, Vite build tooling.
- Vitest + React Testing Library for tests.

## Backend

- Python, FastAPI.
- SQLite for local development, via SQLAlchemy.
- Pytest for tests.

## Auth

- Email/password with hashed passwords and session cookies.
